-- HERBARIUM SAMPLES (AX3)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS perfumum_herbarium_samples (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  herbarium_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  plant_latin_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  year INT,
  collection VARCHAR(255),
  repository VARCHAR(255),
  sample_type ENUM('pressed_leaf', 'flower', 'seed', 'bark', 'root', 'whole_plant') DEFAULT 'pressed_leaf',
  allowed_sampling BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX3_ANALYTICAL_TRANS_EPOCH',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX phs_plant_idx (plant_latin_name),
  INDEX phs_year_idx (year)
);

-- GCMS RUNS (AX3)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS perfumum_gcms_runs (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  sample_ref VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  method ENUM('GC-MS', 'GC-MS/MS', 'HS-SPME-GC-MS', 'LC-MS', 'Other') NOT NULL,
  instrument VARCHAR(255),
  run_date DATE,
  standards JSON,
  top_compounds JSON,
  data_file VARCHAR(500),
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX3_ANALYTICAL_TRANS_EPOCH',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX pgr_sample_idx (sample_ref)
);

-- MOLECULAR MARKERS (AX3)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS molecular_markers (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  marker_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  botanical_family VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  molecule_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  cas_number VARCHAR(20),
  typical_percentage DECIMAL(5,2),
  is_key_marker BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  biosynthesis_pathway VARCHAR(100),
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX3_ANALYTICAL_TRANS_EPOCH',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX mm_family_idx (botanical_family)
);
